landing.engineSubtitle: A seamless ecosystem connecting every aspect of the gym experience.
landing.msg2: Thanks coach! Aiming for a PR next week.
landing.feat1Desc: Instant class reservation with real-time capacity management.
landing.feat2Desc: Direct communication channel between members and trainers.
landing.feat3Desc: Push notifications for gym announcements and schedule changes.
landing.arBody: Gyms can now offer AR-guided workouts that help members train safely and correctly. Our computer vision technology analyzes form in real-time, preventing injuries and maximizing results without needing a personal trainer for every rep.
landing.whySubtitle: Complete infrastructure for the modern fitness facility.
landing.whyCardDesc: Easily manage member profiles, subscriptions and payments in one secure place.
landing.how1Desc: Create your gym profile and import your existing member database.
landing.how2Desc: Set up class schedules, trainer availability, and AR zones.
landing.how3Desc: Members download the app and instantly sync with your facility.
landing.how4Desc: Monitor capacity, bookings, and revenue from one dashboard.
landing.ctaTopBody: FITUP collaborates with gyms—we don't own them. Our mission is to empower your brand with the technology needed to compete in a digital-first world.
landing.whyCard1Desc: Automated membership renewals and access control.
landing.whyCard2Desc: Seamless class and equipment reservation for members.
landing.whyCard3Desc: Push targeted updates to specific member groups.
landing.whyCard4Desc: Visual data analytics for member performance.
landing.whyCard5Desc: Self-guided training with augmented reality oversight.
landing.whyCard6Desc: Heatmaps and usage stats for gym floor optimization.
landing.solutionOutcome1: Higher member retention with consistent engagement
landing.solutionOutcome2: Faster operations with less manual overhead
landing.solutionOutcome3: Stronger visibility across member behavior and capacity
landing.solution1Body: Smart Management centralizes member lifecycle operations. Gym teams can automate renewals, streamline access control, and reduce repetitive front-desk tasks while improving accuracy and security across locations.
landing.solution2Body: Booking System gives members instant visibility into classes, sessions, and equipment slots. It reduces conflicts, prevents overbooking, and keeps schedules synchronized for members, coaches, and operations staff.
landing.solution3Body: Announcements helps your gym deliver targeted communication to the right audience. Send updates by branch, membership type, or activity segment so members only receive relevant messages at the right time.
landing.solution4Body: Progress Tracking turns workout and attendance data into clear visual trends. Coaches and members can track consistency, milestones, and performance improvements with actionable dashboards.
landing.solution5Body: AR Support enables guided workouts with augmented overlays and posture cues. Members can train more confidently while coaches scale guidance quality beyond one-to-one supervision.
landing.solution6Body: Real-Time Analytics provides live insights such as heatmaps, peak-hour usage, and engagement patterns. Use this data to optimize floor layout, staffing, and program planning.
landing.solution1Cap1: Automated renewals and plan lifecycle controls
landing.solution1Cap2: Role-based access permissions for staff and members
landing.solution2Cap3: Unified schedules for members and coaches
landing.solution3Cap1: Segmented broadcasts by branch and member type
landing.solution4Cap2: Attendance, consistency, and training trend analysis
landing.solution5Cap3: Scalable coaching experience with AR layers
landing.solution6Cap1: Heatmaps for floor and equipment utilization
landing.solution6Cap3: Real-time usage insights for capacity planning
